en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a panoramic cityscape dominated by a tall neo‑Gothic church with a slender spire rising above surrounding low buildings. There is a column-like monument on the left and rooftops in the foreground. Printed red text labels the scene and the city; handwritten notes appear along the right margin. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century European postcard.
